_comment: Seed file. Every architectural decision an agent makes is appended here with its rationale, so later agents can see why the codebase looks the way it does. Long-form decisions also get an ADR in the product's docs/ADRs/.

decisions.decision: Layer the API as routes, services and repositories
decisions.rationale: Business rules must be testable without HTTP; persistence must be replaceable without touching routes.
alternatives_considered: Fat route handlers calling Prisma directly
